title: Rapid Ops 1:1 play slate — prep & next-actions
content:
Meeting: quick 1:1 with Iris Kwon — Jun 11 (20m)
Purpose: unblock Iris on the canary, sync on priority tradeoffs (latency vs cost), coaching: proactive escalation and pushback.

Topline objective (what I want to accomplish):
- Confirm current canary status and exact blocker for rollout.
- Agree on next 48h action plan to stabilize p99 for long sequences.
- Coach on framing a concise update for infra/infra-sre and PM.

Agenda (20m total)
- 0:00–02: Quick personal check-in (energy, capacity) — 2 min
- 02–08: Canary status + data (what's changed since last deploy) — 6 min
   * Quick ask: show the two graphs (p50/p95/p99) for tokens>1024, last 24h
   * Root-cause hypothesis: kernel selection fallback + increased tail latency on A100s
- 08–14: Blockers & decisions (what I can unblock) — 6 min
   * PR 1012 tests flaky on stage; need a triage owner + temporary revert?
   * Decide whether to revert to quantized model for canary traffic or keep circuit-breakers
- 14–18: Career/coach (one behavioral point) — 4 min
   * Push on escalation quality: how to structure a 2-line ask to infra and SRE
- 18–20: Action items + recap — 2 min

Metrics & signals I'll ask Iris to pull live:
- p99 latency for seq_len > 1024 (24h, 6h)
- request queue depth at peak windows (last 3 days)
- KV cache hit ratio per model variant
- Error rates by hw-type (A100 vs H100)
- Can take a quick screenshot of the canary dashboard and drop in channel

Current state (notes from prior async updates):
- Canary deployed yesterday at 03:00 UTC; started at 1% traffic, auto-scaled to 4 nodes.
- After ~2 hours, p99 spiked + errors rose on a subset of requests with long contexts.
- Infra put a soft throttle; we opened INF-2390 to track canary rollback triggers.
- PR 1012 adds a kernel selection heuristic; failing intermittently in CI (timeout on integration test).

Hypotheses (rough, for discussion)
- Kernel selection picks a slower kernel for certain attention shapes when sequence > 1024 — causes jitter and queueing.
- Autoscaler mis-estimates CPU usage for the runtime host-process on A100, leading to transient throttles.
- A small memory leak in PR 1012 causes node eviction under sustained load.

What I can offer in-meeting (manager unblocks)
- Call with infra on Iris's behalf to prioritize a perf trace (10–15m sync) if she wants it.
- Reassign a peer (Avery) to own the PR triage this afternoon.
- Approve a short hotfix revert if we need immediate rollback (pre-authorized).

Questions I want Iris to come prepared to answer (keep to 1–2 quick bullets):
- Which exact tests in PR 1012 are failing and any stack traces? (one-liner)
- If we revert, how fast can we re-run the quantized canary and expect stable numbers? (estimate)
- Do we have an easy telemetry query to show KV cache hit rate by model variant? (yes/no + where)

Coaching note (behavioral):
- Work on escalation concision: 1) one-sentence impact, 2) one-sentence ask, 3) attach minimal logs/trace.
- Practice this live: I'll role-play a 30s escalation during the meeting if she wants.

Draft 1-line summary to post in #infra-canary after our sync (I'll ask Iris to approve):
"Canary INF-2390: observed p99 latency spike for long-context traffic after kernel-selection changes; temporary throttles in place. Requesting prioritized perf trace and triage on PR 1012 — assigning Avery to triage. TL;DR: need confirm whether kernel fallback or memory pressure is root cause."

Action items (owner -> due) — fill in during meeting:
- Iris: paste last-24h p99/p95 snapshots into ticket INF-2390 (due: today EOD)
- Avery: run flaky CI test locally + open follow-up PR with narrower change set (due: tomorrow noon)
- Taylor (me): escalate to infra lead and schedule a 15m perf trace meeting if required (due: today afternoon)
- Iris: add simple query for KV cache hit ratio by variant to the canary dashboard (due: tomorrow EOD)

Personal quick notes (scratch, keep brief):
- Tone: calm, focus on data and next step. Avoid public blame.
- If Iris is low on bandwidth, propose a shorter block-and-handoff model (I assign Avery + PR owner).
- If she pushes to keep canary live, confirm rollback plan and SLOs for the revert window.

Open questions to follow-up after meeting:
- If root cause is kernel selection, who owns short-term mitigation (runtime team vs kernel authors)?
- Should we add an automatic KV-cache warmup for variant rollouts? (pros/cons)

References (quick copy for chat):
- INF-2314: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-2314
- INF-2390: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-2390
- PR 1012: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1012

Note to self after meeting: write crisp follow-up email to infra & PM with outcome + next-steps; follow-up on Avery's triage by EOD tomorrow.
